topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I'm here, standing in front of Professor Ellis, the weight of the room pressing down on me. The accusation hangs in the air, thick and unyielding. “Plagiarism,” she says, her voice steady, eyes searching mine. I swallow hard, my mouth dry. I didn’t mean to. I always cite my sources, always. Maybe I missed something, a reference, a comma, a line. I start to explain, my words tumbling over each other, my hands fidgeting with the edge of my notebook. I can see the skepticism in her expression, and I know I need to prove my integrity, to show her that I respect the work of others, that I would never intentionally steal someone else’s words.
